title: model catalog bot PR workflow: reviewer and label policy must be applied on both the create and the existing-PR edit paths
answers: Model catalog daily refresh PR is still requesting TomeHirata as reviewer after the policy change; how do I remove it from open PRs?
Why does an already-open model catalog PR not get the team-review label when the workflow reruns?
Where does the update-model-catalog workflow add reviewers and labels when it creates or reuses a PR?
How do I change the labels applied by the LiteLLM model pricing bot PR without leaving existing PRs inconsistent?
body:
Path: .github/workflows/update-model-catalog.yml, the PR step that looks up an open PR for the bot branch with `gh pr list --head "$branch"` and then either runs `gh pr edit "$existing_pr"` (rerun path) or `gh pr create` (first run of the day). This is where the daily LiteLLM-sourced model catalog refresh gets its reviewer and labels.
Rule: `gh pr create` flags (`--reviewer`, `--label`) only affect newly created PRs. Any reviewer or label policy change must also be made in the existing-PR `gh pr edit` branch, using `--remove-reviewer` for old reviewers and `--add-label` for new labels. The PR establishes this pattern: the edit branch now removes `TomeHirata` and adds both `auto-rerun` and `team-review`, and the create branch adds the same labels without `--reviewer`.
Symptom: After the policy change, newly created model catalog PRs had the new labels, but a PR that was already open kept the old reviewer and lacked `team-review`, because every daily rerun only edited it with `auto-rerun`.
Constraints: Applies to the bot branch PR in this workflow only. Keep `auto-rerun` on both paths, since the rerun trigger depends on it. Do not assume a label or reviewer change reaches an open PR without editing that branch as well.
applies: Changing reviewers or labels on the auto-generated model catalog PR in update-model-catalog.yml; not other bot workflows.
says: Automated model catalog pull requests continue requesting retired reviewers after policy updates.
Existing model catalog bot pull requests lack required team review labels on reruns.
Update daily model pricing refresh pull requests to reflect new reviewer assignment rules.
Ensure automated model updates apply review tags to already open pull requests.
Daily catalog refresh pull requests retain obsolete reviewers on recurring automated runs.
search: The daily model catalog refresh workflow in `.github/workflows/update-model-catalog.yml` must apply reviewer and label policy updates to both `gh pr create` and existing-PR `gh pr edit` branches. When updating policies, the edit branch must explicitly pass `--remove-reviewer` for retired reviewers and `--add-label` for new labels such as `team-review` to prevent open PRs from remaining inconsistent. Applies exclusively to the model catalog bot branch pull requests, requiring `auto-rerun` to be retained on both execution paths.
